thread:
kevin: CI turned red on linux-x64 after yesterday's toolchain image roll. lots of linker errors in model-serving native target.
kevin: example: ```/usr/bin/ld: build/lib/libnn.so: undefined reference to `std::filesystem::path::string()`
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status```
ci-bot: Build https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/infra/pipelines/main/builds/5421 failed on linux-x64 (toolchain-roll). tests: 12 failed, 3 flaky.
maggie: ugh. is this happening on other arches or just linux-x64? :thinking_face:
lina: only saw linux-x64 in the matrix so far. windows/mac green. Might be an ABI change in the gcc/stdlib shipped in the new image.
derek: can someone bisect the toolchain image tag? if it's an image change it's probably between toolchain:v2026-03-15 and toolchain:v2026-03-16.
kevin: @chris merged the bump PR yesterday (tools/toolchain#98). @chris can you confirm what was in that image?
chris: yep, I bumped to gcc 12.3 + libstdc++ patched. main diff is /etc/ld.so.conf changes and a different libstdc++ packaging. didn't expect ABI break but could be subtle.
maggie: can we rerun CI just to be sure it's not a transient? one-click rerun on that job should be cheap.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by maggie. Triggered rebuild: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/infra/pipelines/main/builds/5422 (in progress).
derek: while that's running, quick local repro steps: checkout main, `bazel build //services/model-serving:server --config=linux-x64 --verbose_failures` then `ldd bazel-bin/services/model-serving/server` shows missing symbols. i reproduced on a ubuntu:22.04 dev container using the new toolchain image.
lina: sounds like the link line is pulling in libstdc++ not matching headers. possibly we need `-D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0` change or recompile dependencies with new ABI.
kevin: we should bisect. @derek if you can bisect the image tags and report the first bad tag that would be helpful. add a note in the toolchain bump PR so we can revert quickly if needed.
derek: starting bisect now. will try tags between v2026-03-14 and v2026-03-17. ETA ~30m.
maggie: pinging release coordinator to hold any deploys that depend on that image. added label `hold-deploy` to the PR.
chris: thanks — if derek finds the exact package change I can rebuild the image without it.
derek: bisect update: first bad tag identified v2026-03-16-rc1. diff shows libstdc++ package switched from `libstdc++6` (ubuntu default) to a custom build with backports.
kevin: nice. temporary mitigation: add a compatibility symlink or force the previous libstdc++ package in the image for linux-x64 jobs. can someone open a quick revert PR for the toolchain bump?
chris: opening PR now: tools/toolchain#99 (revert bump to v2026-03-15). I'll mark it as urgent.
maggie: CI rerun completed: build 5422 still fails -> confirms regression.
kevin: ok, next steps: push revert, wait for green, then create a follow-up to evaluate the custom libstdc++ and why it was introduced. assign to @chris and @lina.
derek: added bisect findings to tools/toolchain#98 conversation and attached the failing `nm` output.
kevin: thanks all. if anyone sees other flaky/similar linker errors, drop them in this thread. :thumbsup:
chris: PR 99 opened and linked. invoking ci rerun on that once merged.
ci-bot: PR tools/toolchain#99 created by chris. build triggered: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/infra/pipelines/toolchain/builds/128 (waiting for approval).
maggie: approving the revert now.
kevin: keeping this thread open until build green.
